summary: Shared prompt->query hygiene for ALL THREE recall hooks (kb-recall.mjs, cursor-kb-recall.mjs, codex-kb-recall.mjs each import recallQuery; they previously duplicated the same one-liner). Exports HARNESS_TAGS (a NAMED union across hosts: system-reminder, ide_opened_file, ide_selection, ide_diagnostics, task-notification, local-command-*, command-*, user-prompt-submit-hook, browser_instruction, environment_context, user_instructions), stripHarnessWrappers (removes those tags AND their content, up to 4 passes for nesting, then lone/truncated tags) and recallQuery(raw,max) = strip THEN truncate. Two design constraints that look like details but are the whole point: the strip must precede the MAX_QUERY_CHARS(2000) slice or a long <ide_selection> eats the budget and the real question is cut off; and only NAMED tags are stripped, never arbitrary markup, because over-stripping silently drops genuine questions (a user pasting <div> must survive). An all-telemetry prompt yields '' so the caller skips the search entirely. Fail-open: any throw returns the raw text.
